sub_palette: near_eastern (old_persian / Achaemenid register) backbone + east_asian (sinitic) substrate (cross-family blend, Persian-leaning)

blend.backbone: near_eastern (old persian / Achaemenid register: Xshayathiya/satrap rulership, the ezafe genitive-of-relation '-ahya', vowel-length, the -aspa/-arta/-farnah elements, retained th/x/f spirants, Arta the Truth and the king's farnah-glory)
blend.overlay: east_asian (sinitic: the Mandate-of-Heaven mandarin bureaucracy, the walled cheng river-cities, the silk and jade and tea of the caravan-road, monosyllabic roots, -di/-jun/-wang celestial titles, SVO isolating syntax)
blend.lean: Persian-heavy - a Sogdian-Iranian caravan-court reaching east into Cathay, the Shah and his satraps enthroned over a Sinitic mandarin order: the Old-Persian ezafe and the court register dominate, the Sinitic bureaucracy of scribes and silk-rivers endures and serves beneath. The ezafe and the Mandate fused.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_04 (Old Persian / Achaemenid, the Axsatran backbone) x BASE_09 (Sinitic / Chinese, the Jinxian substrate). CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: both parents are Civilized (Persian satrapal empire + Sinitic Mandate realm), and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Zarhua is Civilized (feudal). Concept: a Perso-Sinitic silk-road empire - Sogdiana reaching Cathay. An Iranian caravan-court that drove east along the silk-road, married the river-valley mandarin order of the east, and set up as Shah-of-shahs over a Sinitic bureaucracy: the ezafe and the Mandate fused, caravan-court and mandarin. Backbone = Old Persian (the ruling court, the Xshayathiya/satrap register, the ezafe, Arta and farnah); overlay/substrate = Sinitic (the cheng river-cities, the silk/jade/tea trade-goods, the mandarin scribal bureaucracy, the Mandate of Heaven). Common-word lexicon is a SINGLE FUSED tongue (Sinitic material/river/bureaucratic roots + Persian rule/kin/court/land roots, all run through one Old-Persian-shaped sound-law); rank titles are English DISPLAY with Old-Persian *_native forms. DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Persian-shifted reflexes PRIMARY, the Axsatran set; Sinitic morphs SECONDARY, the Jinxian/family_east_asian sinitic set), never real Iranian/Zoroastrian/Chinese gods. The cardinal virtue ARTA (Truth) carries over from the Persian backbone; the Mandate of Heaven (Tianming, morphed Tian-farnah) legitimizes the throne. All human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic. Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are English with the approved foreign term 'Shah' at the kingdom tier (commonly-known); conlang titles in ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue.

phonology.palette: Old Persian (Indo-Iranian) backbone - vowels a i u with long a/i/u, spirants th(0)/x(kh)/f, sibilants s/sh/z/zh and c(ts), r l, nasals m n, semivowels y v/w, aspirate h, the signature endings -a/-ah/-ish/-iya/-ana/-aspa/-arta/-farnah, the ezafe '-i-' and the genitive-of-relation '-ahya' - meeting a Sinitic substrate: monosyllabic roots, finals -n/-ng, the -di/-jun/-wang celestial titles, the silk-and-river trade vocabulary. Per the CSV: analytic flow with rich vowel length, the Sinitic monosyllables stretched onto Persian flowing vowels and bound by the ezafe; grammar is SVO with isolating poetic syntax (the Sinitic word-order carried on Old-Persian connective particles, no heavy case-stacking). Theophoric on the Persian-shifted reflexes (Turvasa-, Urlaspa-, Arta-) with Sinitic deity-variants beneath (Tuli-, Gaidun-).
phonology.phonotactics: CV(C) with Persian clusters xsh-, sp-, st-, fr-, vr-, thr- at onset, but a strong pull toward the open Sinitic syllable medially (the borrowed monosyllables stay light); finals -n/-ng tolerated from the substrate; vowel length distinctive; stress on heavy syllables with a poetic, end-weighted lilt; the ezafe '-i-' links noun to qualifier (rud-i-zar, the river of gold).

sound_changes: Sinitic tones dropped entirely; the bare monosyllable kept as a light root (jiang>jang, si>si, cheng>cheng)
Sinitic isolating monosyllables fitted to Persian flowing vowels: a final consonant root may take a Persian -a/-ah, and short roots lengthen a vowel to scan (mi>maya, yu>yuva, ze>zaya)
Sinitic finals -n/-ng retained but Persian onset-clusters (xsh-, sp-, st-, fr-, thr-) permitted; no tone, no Sinitic retroflex zh/ch - they soften to sh/c/j
the ezafe '-i-' and the relation-particle '-ahya' bind compounds in place of Sinitic juxtaposition; Old-Persian end-weighted stress on all words
retain Persian th/x/f, the -aspa/-arta/-farnah endings and Arta-theophorics; very short Sinitic roots take a Persian vowel-ending to flow
fusion_rules.source_tilt: river/silk/bureaucratic/material/trade words from Sinitic roots (the eastern river-cities and the caravan goods - silk, jade, tea, the mandarin office); rule/kin/court/land/quality/war words from Old Persian roots (the ruling court register); every root then filtered to one Old-Persian-shaped phonology so the split is invisible at the surface

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Sinitic river/silk/material/bureaucratic roots + Old-Persian rule/kin/court/land roots, all run through one Old-Persian-shaped sound-law (tones dropped, monosyllables fitted to flowing Persian vowels, bound by the ezafe); portmanteaus mark the silk-road institutions where the caravan-court and the mandarin order married. One language - Persian-shaped, Sinitic-substrated - not a slash list.

toponymic_suffixes: Dida- / -zhaida (fort of; Persian dida fused with Sinitic zhai)
morphology.patronymic_form: the Old-Persian court nobility carry a house (vith-X) and a satrapal/court office, with filiation 'X-ahya ziputhra' (son of X) or compact 'X-ziputhra'; the Sinitic mandarin populace keep a clan-root (zu) + given name and an examination-rank; the throne fuses both - a Shah who carries a vith-house and holds the Mandate over the cheng-cities.

gendered_endings.male: -a / -ah / -aspa / -arta (Persian court); a clan-root + auspicious given (Sinitic substrate)

morphology.compounding_rule: Old-Persian ezafe and relation-construct ([noun]-i-[qualifier]: rud-i-zar, river-of-gold; Arta-xshaca, truth-realm; X-ahya) layered over Sinitic feature+type juxtaposition (Jang-cheng, river-city; Yuva-patha, jade-road): the capital Zarhua (Zar-hua, the golden river-flower), Dida-Turvasa (fort of Turvasa), Jang-pura (the river-city).

title_ladder.government: feudal (an Old-Persian caravan-court over the Sinitic mandarin cities: the Shah and his vith-kin at the crown holding the Mandate, the satrap-governors over the cheng-provinces, the asabara cavalier-retainers sworn to the road; the mandarin shi-officials and the magi-scribes serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Old-Persian ladder, ascending, with the Sinitic mandarin substrate beneath. Vispati (clan-lord of a vis) barony; Marzapana (march-warden, the marzban) march; Framatar (appointed director/governor) county over a Parada; Xshacapavan (SATRAP, protector of the realm) duchy over a satrapy; Vispuhra (prince of the blood) principality over a great province (Dahyu); Xshayathiya (king) kingdom - DISPLAYED as Shah (the approved foreign term, commonly-known) - over a Xshacam; Xshayathiya Xshayathiyanam (King of Kings) empire over the Vispa-Dahyu, all the lands. The eastern cities keep their Sinitic Dudu (frontier military command) and the mandarin Bo/Hou peerage and the shi-officials beneath the Persian crown; the magi (Magu) and the scribal mandarins stand outside the ladder. Rank DISPLAY titles are English (with Shah at kingdom); the Old-Persian *_native forms are for dialogue.
title_ladder.heir: Mathishta (the greatest; crown prince) / Visa-ziputhra (the Shah's son; the heir)

vassalage.vassal: Bandaka (the Shah's loyal bondsman) / Chen (Sinitic subject)

title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH, with the approved foreign term 'Shah' at the kingdom tier (commonly-known, recorded in approved_foreign_terms_used). The *_native conlang forms (Old-Persian, with Sinitic co-titles) are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Old-Persian court nobility carry a theophoric or Arta-/Vahu- virtue given-name + filiation (X-ziputhra) + a vith-house and office; the Sinitic mandarin stock carry a clan-root + an auspicious given name + an examination-rank; order given-first for the Persian court, clan-first for the mandarin substrate, with the court register prevailing at the throne.
surname_source: office (satrap, marzban, mandarin-rank) or earned silk-road epithet
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Persian caravan-court nobility carry a vith-house, a theophoric/virtue name and a court-satrapal office; the Sinitic mandarin city-folk carry a clan-root + auspicious given name and an examination-rank.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Persian court names from the shifted deity-stems + an Old-Persian element: Baga-X (god-X), X-data (X-given), X-farnah (glory-of-X), Vahu-X (good-X), Arta- (truth-): Turvasa-data, Baga-Urlaspa, Artafarnah, Vahu-Arzanta; the Sinitic substrate invokes the celestial powers' epithets and the Mandate (Tian-en, heaven's grace) on the Sinitic morph-stems (Tuli-, Gaidun-).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Old-Persian-shifted reflexes PRIMARY (the Axsatran set: Turvasa, Urlaspa, Naumana, Arzanta, Gayanta, Riyata, Asturna), Sinitic morphs SECONDARY (the Jinxian / family_east_asian sinitic set: Tuli-di, Gaidun-di, Numeng-jun, Lianta-mu), recognizably the same powers under two faces, never real Iranian/Zoroastrian/Chinese gods. Lawful henotheist but TOLERANT (the silk-road empire shelters its subject cults): Asturna the Wise Lord Most High upholds ARTA (Truth/Right-order) and the Lawful powers are His yazata-ministers; the Mandate of Heaven (morphed Tian-farnah) legitimizes the Shah; the Chaotic powers are the hosts of DRAUGA (the Lie). The cardinal sin is the Lie. All three alignments are playable.
religion.the_one: Asturna (< Aeternus / the Persian-shifted Itarnu; the Sinitic face Aiteng, the Highest Heaven) - the Wise Lord Most High, upholder of Arta and source of the Shah's farnah-glory and the Mandate, revered above His ministers, honored not petitioned

sample_deity_renames.Tulrius: Turvasa (Sinitic Tuli-di) - the sun and Arta, lamp of right-order; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Orlandus: Urlaspa (Sinitic Aolan) - the iron-oath, war and the cavalier; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Numeno: Naumana (Sinitic Numeng-jun) - the good mind, wisdom and the law; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Argentus: Arzanta (Sinitic Argan) - trade, the silk-road and increase; Lawful
sample_deity_renames.Gaiandus: Gayanta (Sinitic Gaidun-di) - the enduring earth and mountain
sample_deity_renames.Realta: Riyata (Sinitic Lianta-mu) - the Lady of Waters, mother and mercy

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: venerates the Lawful powers - Asturna the Wise Lord, Turvasa of Arta, Urlaspa of the sworn war, Riyata the merciful - upholds Arta against Drauga the Lie, and names the Chaotic powers the hosts of the Lie, warded; the Shah's farnah and the Mandate of Heaven bind the realm.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: honors the fravashi (the honored fore-spirits) of the court-houses and the Sinitic zu-ancestors and the local earth-and-grain and river powers; the great powers invoked at the fire-altar and the miao situationally; the road and the harvest kept.
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: Venerates the Chaotic powers of the canon, the hosts of Drauga, and names the Lawful powers - and Asturna - as the tyrant-gods to be defied; the Lie made a creed.

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the Chaotic powers, warded as the hosts of Drauga the Lie (Sinitic mo, demon-marshals), keep their shifted morph + a hostile portfolio-epithet: Maraxus -> Marakhsha the Burner-of-Cities (Sinitic Maluo the War-Fire Marshal); Vacidus -> Vakida the Devouring-Void (Sinitic Wuci the Devourer); Lusanto -> Lusanta the Coin-Serpent (Sinitic Lusan; the Lie made gold).

clergy_ladder.5: Magupati (chief magus of a fire-temple) / Fashi (ritual-master)
clergy_ladder.9: Magupatan Magupat (the chief of chief magi) / Tianshi (celestial master)

religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Atash ([fire] of [power]) and its fire-temple (Atashana), or the Sinitic Miao (temple) of [power]: 'the Atashana of Turvasa', 'the Miao of Tuli-di'; the magi keep the ever-burning fire (Atar) on the altar.
religion.saints_pattern: the honest dead and the just shahs and worthy mandarins, kept as fravashi (fore-spirits) and enrolled in the celestial register, petitioned at the fire-altar and the ancestral Ci (clan-shrine); 'the Arta-true [name]' (the righteous [name]).

holy_symbol_motifs.Asturna: a winged ring-disc (the farnah-glory) above a fire-altar, ringed by the silk-road circuit
holy_symbol_motifs.Turvasa: a rayed sun above the upright Arta-measure and the seal of office
holy_symbol_motifs.Urlaspa: an iron spear crossed with an oath-ring over the caravan-standard

banks_patterns.military_units: the [number/power] Spada (host) and the cavalier wings and the city banners: 'the Spada of Urlaspa', 'the Ten-Thousand (Anushiya)', 'the Azure Banner of the Jang'

banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: fallen apadana-halls and dead fire-temples and ruined frontier-cheng: 'the dead Atashana of [name]', 'the buried Apadana of Dida-[name]', 'the Ruined Cheng of [satrap]'
